_about: v2.8 plan 11, contract B (create-B): a create card survives only when its title or its first key is named by >= 2 distinct live facts, and no listed or hidden entry already holds that title or key. Revision 2, written and labelled 2026-10-09 BEFORE any model answer was read (v2.3 plan-10 audit rule); new ids (p16+, n17+) so no revision-1 record can be read as theirs. English only (v2.6 W25), synthetic (no campaign text). A 'propose' case has an entity named by >= 2 distinct facts and no entry; the sample passes when >= 1 create card survives the shipped guards AND names the case's entity. A 'none' case passes only when no create card survives. `hidden` rows are entries the curator is never shown (a stagecraft.exclude row, or an entry a checkpoint's world_info gates): a card must not recreate them beside the original. Floors carried from v2.3 plan 10 and never retuned: propose >= 0.90 of samples, none = 1.00 of samples, in both runs. Do not edit a label after a run; add a case under a new id and bump the revision instead. The sha256 of this file is pinned in src/stagecraft/createCandidate.test.ts.
